The corrected theorem specifies the iterated order, not a joint necessary cell-count law. For E(k)=pi-k, direct integration yields lim_{beta->infty} S_M(beta)=log(2)/(2M) at every fixed M while C_E(beta) grows linearly in beta. This refutes the original unqualified scaling consequence and validates its removal from the final claim.
